automationNotes: Doc: [Delete an Event](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/delete-event) — **Delete a Non-referenced Event** only (not the referenced-event / A/B Metrics path). Destructive. Row ⋮ → **Delete** → **Delete Event** modal → **Delete**. Set **`PERSONALIZE_DELETE_EVENT_ROW_CONTAINS`** (default **`AUTO_EVENT`**) to a disposable event row (e.g. from **`create-event`**). **`stage: delete`** runs after `main`.
